whenToUse: A contractor, builder or developer site with projects, progress, services, safety and tender enquiries.
Firms that want per-project pages with a draggable progress timeline.
avoidWhen: A residential sales agency — use site-estate-01.
a11y: Timeline and filter changes are announced through aria-live; hazard and progress motion stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
Make sure the dragged timeline month is also reachable with arrow keys or the visible month labels.
